checklist.item: Visit https://hackenproof.com/programs/cetus-smart-contracts to confirm live scope, in-scope Move packages, excluded contracts, and exact submission format/rules.
Clone the official Cetus Sui/Move git repository referenced on the program page.
Run agents/external_audit.py on the cloned repo, pointing it at core packages (cetus-clmm, cetus-lending, oracle modules).
Trigger Move Prover/sui-prover formal verification via the agent on key invariants such as liquidity math and capability checks.
Use the agent's frontier-LLM review pass to surface access-control, capability-leak, and storage-collision candidates.
Manually inspect results against Move/Sui taxonomy: improper transfer_to_object, missing &mut checks, oracle trust, and business-logic races in swap/lend flows.
Reproduce any flagged issues locally with sui move test or published testnets and capture minimal PoC transactions.
Draft submission with contract addresses, exact Move module versions, step-by-step reproduction, and severity justification matching Hackenproof template.

Verify the current scope, rules, and payout tiers for the Cetus Smart Contracts bug bounty program on the HackenProof platform by checking the program's page directly at https://hackenproof.com/programs/cetus-smart-contracts.
Identify the target Move/Sui smart contracts to audit, which should be accessible via a provided git repository or other means as specified in the program details.
Run agents/external_audit.py on the identified target smart contracts to perform source fetching, Move Prover/sui-prover formal verification where applicable, and frontier-LLM review.
Analyze the output from agents/external_audit.py for potential vulnerabilities, focusing on common issues such as access control, oracle trust, and business logic flaws.
Manually review the smart contracts against a real vulnerability taxonomy to check for reentrancy, front-running, and other potential attack vectors that may not have been caught by automated tools.
Investigate any findings from the automated and manual reviews to confirm their validity and assess their potential impact on the Cetus Smart Contracts.
Document all confirmed vulnerabilities, including steps to reproduce, expected behavior, and actual behavior, to prepare a comprehensive submission.
Ensure that the submission adheres to the format and guidelines specified by the Cetus Smart Contracts bug bounty program on HackenProof.
Submit the documented vulnerabilities to the program, ensuring that all required information is included and that the submission is made within the program's specified timeframe and guidelines.
